activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyFiltered: Nothing in this period · try another range
activity.emptyDefault: Nothing yet today · it's watching for you
activity.triggerFiredHint: Fired: the condition was met. If the action was empty, on cooldown, or failed, nothing may have actually happened.
activity.triggerStillInHint: Ongoing: the condition still holds, but it already fired on entry, so it won't fire again.
activity.triggerCountingHint: Timing: this rule needs to hold for a while; the time or match rate isn't there yet.
activity.triggerNotFiredHint: No fire: still confirming, the rule is off, or nothing ran this time.
activity.triggerUnknownHint: Unknown: this check didn't finish, so we can't tell. See backend logs.
